-- Spec for make_ids: n distinct record ids, same on every run for the same seed.
-- No capabilities are granted, so no `uses` clause appears anywhere.

is_distinct(xs: List[int]) -> bool =
  ex is_distinct([1, 2, 3]) == True
  ex is_distinct([4, 4]) == False
  for i in range(0, xs.len())
    for j in range(i + 1, xs.len())
      if xs[i] == xs[j]
        return False
  True

mix(x: int) -> int =
  ex mix(0) == mix(0)
  let a = ((x % 1000000007) * 31 + 17) % 1000000007
  (a * 31 + 17) % 1000000007

make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  post out.len() == n
  post is_distinct(out)
  ex make_ids(0, 7) == []
  ex make_ids(3, 42) == make_ids(3, 42)
  -- Each id is i * 1000003 + r, where r depends only on seed.
  -- Distinct i give distinct ids, so the result is distinct.
  let r = mix(seed) % 1000003
  var out: List[int] = []
  for i in range(0, n)
    out.append(i * 1000003 + r)
  out
